decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the firm's docking and apron expertise and has its own web page, and the firm's in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product.
The apron connectivity module builds on the installed gate and docking equipment base, so the firm can assimilate feedback and integrate it into its digital platform strategy.

Revenue calculation and billing lies furthest from the firm's operational engineering core, which raises drop risk, but it builds on airport data integration and the firm's R&D can extend the related knowledge.
Monitoring apron equipment draws directly on the firm's installed equipment and maintenance experience, so it is easy to learn from and improve.
Apron resource management is close to the firm's established offer and fits its move toward data-driven, integrated airside operations.
The controller safety alert service builds on the firm's tower, traffic control and surveillance knowledge, so the firm can interpret its results and develop it further.
